Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll construct queries for each task. The language uses pipe syntax `|`, field access `/field`, transformation with `*`, and various verbs like `filter`, `sort`, `count`, etc.

H1: | filter ((/active | eq true) & ((/country | lowercase) | eq "de") & (/age | type | eq "number") & (/age | gt 29)) | * /name | sort

H2: | filter (/status | lowercase | eq "paid") | * /items | flatten | map (/qty * /price) | sum | round 2

H3: | group_by (/customer | lowercase) | map_values (. | count)

H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts ((/scripts | keys) | sort)}

H5: | filter (/state | eq "open") | sort_by (-/comments /id) | take 3 | * /id

H6: | * (/labels | default []) | flatten | * (. | lowercase) | unique | sort

H7: | filter (/state | eq "open") | group_by ((/assignee | /login) | default "unassigned") | map_values (. | count)

H8: | split "\n" | * (. | split " ") | filter (/1 | eq "ERROR") | group_by /2 | map_values (. | count)

H9: | split "\n" | * (. | split " ") | filter ((/1 | in ["ERROR" "WARN"])) | * /3 | * (. | split " " | filter (. | starts_with "user=") | * (. | split "=" | /1)) | flatten | unique | sort

H10: | split "\n" | skip 1 | * (. | split ",") | filter ((/4 | lowercase | eq "up") & (/2 | ne "")) | group_by /1 | map_values (. | * (/2 | to_number) | average | round 1)

H11: | split "\n" | filter (. | ne "") | filter (not (. | starts_with "#")) | * (. | split "=") | filter ((/0 | lowercase | starts_with "db_")) | * {:key (/0 | lowercase | substring 3) :value /1} | map_to_object

H12: /services | filter (/enabled | eq true) | * {:name /name :timeout (/timeout | default (. | parent_root /defaults /timeout)) :team ((/owner /team) | default "none")} | sort_by /name

H13: /results | filter (/score | gte 50) | sort_by (-/score) | * {first: /profile/first last: /profile/last tags: (/tags | default [])} | * "\(first) \(last): \(tags | join "|")"

H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | split /[^a-zA-Z]+/ | filter (. | ne "") | * (. | lowercase) | group_by . | map_values (. | count) | * {:word key :count value} | sort_by (-count word) | take 3
